answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using memory-hard challenges anchored by a pearl registry. Each agent must continuously wander through an uncacheable state graph locked in physical RAM to generate valid heartbeat proofs. This forces an attacker to dedicate scarce high-bandwidth memory and local hardware bus capacity per identity, blocking any sudden gale of spawned clones. However, high memory footprints unfairly penalize lightweight edge devices.
